subcategory_text: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding privacy are understood and managed.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-9 (Information Security and Privacy Risk Management Strategy), SI-18 (Personally Identifiable Information Quality Management)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.31 (Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements)
GDPR Art. 5, Art. 6, Art. 9, sectoral laws (HIPAA Privacy Rule, GLBA, COPPA, FERPA, etc. where applicable)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.OV-03 (regulatory requirements understood)
implementation_examples: Maintain an authoritative library of applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR, ePrivacy, national laws, sectoral laws, framework-specific obligations)
Map requirements to the controls that satisfy them and the roles that own compliance
Monitor regulator publications for proposed changes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual privacy requirements are documented
Determine whether requirements map to owners and to controls
Determine whether regulatory changes are detected and processed
Determine whether requirements are revisited as services and geographies change
